narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced heavy rain and flooding in southeast Mississippi.
ev: Heavy rains caused roads to be flooded and closed in and around Wiggins.
lsr: ROADS FLOODED AND CLOSED DUE TO FLASH FLOODING IN AND AROUND THE WIGGINS AREA. THEY INCLUDE BIG 4 RD AT BLUFF CREEK RD, RALPH MILLER RD, AND STUMP TEXAS RD.
